ArmorStand.name: Armour Stand
ArmorStand.desc: Some clothes are just too nice to fold away. Why not put them on display instead?

BakedPoteitr.name: Baked Poteitr
BakedPoteitr.desc: Neither boiled nor mashed nor in a stew. Still delicious though!

BatteringRam.name: Battering Ram
BatteringRam.desc: This is a force to be reckoned with. Fuel it up and bring it to your enemies' stronghold for a greater chance of success.

Beech_Sapling.name: Beech sapling
Beech_Sapling.desc: A beech yields good old fashioned wood.

BlackSoup.name: Black Soup
BlackSoup.desc: A perfect balance of sweetness and acidity.

Candle_resin.name: Resin Candle
Candle_resin.desc: A small but incredibly cosy lightsource.

CarrotSoup.name: Carrot Soup
CarrotSoup.desc: A warm tasty soup made of mostly carrots.

Cart.name: Cart
Cart.desc: Convenient when you need to move a lot of resources around.

Catapult.name: Catapult
Catapult.desc: If you can't go through it, perhaps you can go over it...

CookedAsksvinMeat.name: Cooked Asksvin Tail
CookedAsksvinMeat.desc: This meat has a potent and mature flavour, but is very tasty when grilled right.

CookedBoneMawSerpentMeat.name: Cooked Bonemaw Meat
CookedBoneMawSerpentMeat.desc: The boiling sea did nothing to this meat, but grilling it over the fire has given it a delightful crisp.

CookedBugMeat.name: Cooked Seeker Meat
CookedBugMeat.desc: Succulent white meat. A true delicacy.

CookedLoxMeat.name: Cooked Lox Meat
CookedLoxMeat.desc: A great hunk of tender meat, food fit for Valhalla!

CookedMooseMeat.name: Cooked Moose Meat
CookedMooseMeat.desc: This meat is lean yet full of flavour.

CookedSealBlubber.name: Cooked Seal Blubber
CookedSealBlubber.desc: A chewy meat, with an aftertaste of remorse.

CookedVoltureMeat.name: Cooked Volture Meat
CookedVoltureMeat.desc: A chewy and somewhat dry meat. Some seasoning would probably make it taste better, but it'll fill your stomach regardless.

FeastAshlands.name: Ashlands Gourmet Bowl
FeastAshlands.desc: It's hard to tell whether the steam coming off of this dish is because it's freshly cooked or because of the asksvin meat in it. Either way, the spiced meat together with the vineberries and fiddlehead sprouts is so delicious that it doesn't matter!

FeastBlackforest.name: Black Forest Buffet Platter
FeastBlackforest.desc: You won't be able to resist this platter of delights from the Black Forest! Venison sirloin steaks are served together with spiced thistles and carrots, and the whole meal is tied together with delicious jams. Just have one more bite!

FeastDeepNorth.name: Northern Morning Fare
FeastDeepNorth.desc: Warming and filling, this meal will sustain you even during the coldest of days. Porridge and pancakes pair well with jams and sausages, making it hard not to come back for a second helping!

FeastMeadows.name: Whole Roasted Meadow Boar
FeastMeadows.desc: A boar that has been roasted to perfection, glazed and served atop a bed of greens, with additional cuts of meat on the side. A feast like this is sure to fill your stomach and brighten your day!

FeastMistlands.name: Mushrooms Galore á la Mistlands
FeastMistlands.desc: The time has come for mushroom enthusiasts to rejoice! Try different kinds of mushrooms, mushroom marinated seeker meat and mushroom-filled misthare, and don't miss out on the tasty sap dressing.

FeastMountains.name: Hearty Mountain Logger's Stew
FeastMountains.desc: Gather around this steaming pot full of deliciousness and warm yourselves up again after a day out in the cold. The usually tough and chewey wolf meat has become tender enough to practically melt in your mouth, and the onions and carrots are made even tastier with exciting spices.

FeastOceans.name: Sailor's Bounty
FeastOceans.desc: Fish, fish, and more fish! And also serpent meat, cut to look like fish! Explore the flavours of the Ocean, along with some grilled greens for those still practicing their sea legs.

FeastPlains.name: Plains Pie Picnic
FeastPlains.desc: There's nothing plain about this feast! Enjoy pies and loaves fresh from the oven, both sweet and savoury, and experience the culinary equivalent of a hug.

FeastSwamps.name: Swamp Dweller's Delight
FeastSwamps.desc: Who knew that leeches were edible? With the correct preparation (lots of cooking and lots of seasoning) you will be able to serve them in this feast for the culinary brave. For those who have a sensitive stomach, there are also tasty skewers of sausages and turnips on the side.

FierySvinstew.name: Fiery Svinstew
FierySvinstew.desc: This musty stew is a necessity on every adventurer's menu.

FirTree_Sapling.name: Fir Sapling
FirTree_Sapling.desc: A pretty tree, all year round.

FirTree_big_Sapling.name: Timberwood Sapling
FirTree_big_Sapling.desc: Though native to the northern regions, this tree can grow in most climates.

FishAndBread.name: Fish 'n' Bread
FishAndBread.desc: Bounty from both land and sea.

FishCooked.name: Cooked Fish
FishCooked.desc: A tasty side of smoked fish.

FishWraps.name: Fish Wraps
FishWraps.desc: Bread and fish, what more to wish?

HoneyGlazedChicken.name: Honey Glazed Chicken
HoneyGlazedChicken.desc: Grilled to perfection. Makes both eyes and mouths water.

Karve.name: Karve
Karve.desc: A small and sleek ship, ready to set sail.

LoxPie.name: Lox Meat Pie
LoxPie.desc: Break the crust to release a cloud of fragrant steam. Delicious!

MarinatedGreens.name: Marinated Greens
MarinatedGreens.desc: It's spicy, it's chewy, it's sweet… This mad dish tickles your tongue as well as your mind.

MashedMeat.name: Mashed Meat
MashedMeat.desc: Leftover meat can actually be pretty tasty if you just mash it right!

MeadBugRepellent.name: Anti-Sting Concoction
MeadBugRepellent.desc: The perfect drink for a day in the Plains.

MeadBzerker.name: Berserkir Mead
MeadBzerker.desc: Something poisonous stirs within, brewed to the point where its potential can finally be harnessed. But be careful to let the beast out...

MeadHasty.name: Tonic of Ratatosk
MeadHasty.desc: The squirrel must be quick on its feet as it runs up and down the trunk of the world tree. Although it no longer visits Valheim, there are still those who remember it...

MeadLightfoot.name: Lightfoot Mead
MeadLightfoot.desc: This bottle is full, yet it feels like it weighs almost nothing at all.

MeadStrength.name: Mead of Troll Endurance
MeadStrength.desc: What creature can carry more than a troll? Why, a viking with this drink of course!

MeadSwimmer.name: Draught of Vananidir
MeadSwimmer.desc: You feel invigorated just by holding this, as the ocean beckons you to come for a swim.

MeadTamer.name: Brew of Animal Whispers
MeadTamer.desc: It smells like a pigsty. Likely the taste won't be much better.

MeadTasty.name: Tasty Mead
MeadTasty.desc: The nectar of the Gods, divine mead.

MeadTrollPheromones.name: Love Potion
MeadTrollPheromones.desc: An intense musk permeates the air around this bottle.

MeatballsMashedPoteitr.name: Meatballs and Poteitr
MeatballsMashedPoteitr.desc: It doesn't get more iconic than this!

MinceMeatSauce.name: Minced Meat Sauce
MinceMeatSauce.desc: Chunks of goodness in a thick gravy.

MooseKebab.name: Meat In Bread
MooseKebab.desc: A convenient meal, often favoured by travelling merchants.

Morkhalla_ChestAncient.name: Ancient Chest
Morkhalla_ChestAncient.desc: The sturdy black metal that holds this chest together lets you put almost anything inside.

MushroomBzerker.name: Toadstool
MushroomBzerker.desc: Some say you can eat everything you find in the forest. That is not the case with this mushroom.

MushroomJotunPuffs.name: Jotun Puffs
MushroomJotunPuffs.desc: Swollen with magic, these golden orbs bubble from the ground where the Jotun fell.

MushroomMagecap.name: Magecap
MushroomMagecap.desc: The delicate blue magecaps crackle like nerve-endings with sorcerous vitality.

MushroomOmelette.name: Mushroom Omelette
MushroomOmelette.desc: A delicious omelette with an earthy aftertaste.

MushroomSmokePuff.name: Smoke Puff
MushroomSmokePuff.desc: Hopefully it tastes better after cooking.

NeckTailGrilled.name: Grilled Neck Tail
NeckTailGrilled.desc: This savoury, charcoal-grilled meat has a slight aroma of seaweed and grass.

Oak_Sapling.name: Oak Sapling
Oak_Sapling.desc: With time, this will grow into a large oak.

Oat.name: Oats
Oat.desc: Tasty grains, to be used as they are or to be ground into flour.

OatmealLingonberryJam.name: Oatmeal
OatmealLingonberryJam.desc: Served with a generous helping of lingonberry jam.

Pancakes.name: Pancakes
Pancakes.desc: Was there ever a more comforting food?

Pukeberries.desc: Allows the consumer to quickly evacuate any misplaced meal and start anew.

PulledBear.name: Pulled Bear
PulledBear.desc: Tender meat cooked for hours upon hours, until it practically falls apart.

Raft.name: Raft
Raft.desc: It may not look like much, but a raft will get you farther than swimming!

RoastedCrustPie.desc: This dessert keeps you going all day long.

RottenMeat.name: Rotten Meat
RottenMeat.desc: There are maggots crawling in the meat. It smells awful.

RoyalJelly.name: Royal Jelly
RoyalJelly.desc: Jelly fit for kings and queens.

ScorchingMedley.desc: A varied diet is important, so why not try this vegetarian option?

SeekerAspic.name: Seeker Aspic

SerpentMeatCooked.desc: A cooked slice of sea serpent. Smells good.

SizzlingBerryBroth.name: Sizzling Berry Broth

SmokedMooseMeat.desc: The smoke only adds to the wild flavour.

SparklingShroomshake.name: Sparkling Shroomshake
SparklingShroomshake.desc: Perhaps it's not the best flavour to start the day with, but it will give you the boost you need.

SpicyMarmalade.desc: Sugary honey perfectly balanced with tangy fronds and tart berries.

VikingCupcake.name: Frosted Sweetbread
VikingCupcake.desc: A sweet and tasty treat, to celebrate a feat!

VikingShip.name: Longship
VikingShip.desc: A mighty viking ship for sailing to distant shores.

VikingShip_Ashlands.name: Drakkar
VikingShip_Ashlands.desc: A massive ship, sturdy enough to sail on even the most dangerous seas.

Vineberry.name: Vineberry Cluster
Vineberry.desc: These juicy berries are both sour and sweet.

YggdrasilPorridge.name: Yggdrasil Porridge
YggdrasilPorridge.desc: Made with sap from the great tree. Even a mouthful imparts a warm glow to your whole body.
